keyMappings:
unmap <c-u>
unmap <c-d>
unmap <c-o>
unmap <c-m>
unmap J
unmap K

map <c-d> scrollPageDown
map <c-u> scrollPageUp
map <c-o> goBack
map <c-m> goForward
map <c-p> previousTab
map <c-n> nextTab
